title.en: bric-a-brac and used things at jeu de balle.
title.de: trödel und gebrauchtes am jeu de balle.
title.tr: jeu de balle'da eski eşya ve ikinci el.

line.en: the daily flea market at place du jeu de balle, open until 15:00 on sunday. most stalls take cash only, so bring some.
line.de: der tägliche flohmarkt am place du jeu de balle, sonntags bis 15 uhr. die meisten stände nehmen nur bargeld.
line.tr: place du jeu de balle'daki her gün kurulan pazar, pazar günü 15:00'e kadar açık. çoğu tezgah yalnızca nakit alır.

sparks.why: Jeu de Balle flea market, open daily, weekends until 15:00 (brussels.be outdoor markets; hours differ in other guides). Cash-only note from Brussels Times guides.
